payload.objective: Move sweepers from repaired to controlled: full non-destructive GDrive migration, dedupe auto-approval rules without deletion, live dashboard payload, and receipt verification.

stages.name: verify_stage1_receipts
steps: read receipts/runtime/fix-sweepers-20260424-001/ if present
confirm work_queue/audit rows for fix-sweepers-20260424-001
if stage1 failed, stop stage2 and write blocked receipt with exact failed dependency
verify_sql: select * from ops.work_queue where idempotency_key='fix-sweepers-20260424-001' order by created_at desc limit 5;
select * from audit.log where payload::text ilike '%fix-sweepers-20260424-001%' order by created_at desc limit 20;

stages.name: gdrive_full_migration_non_destructive
steps: select all gdrive_file_index rows where migration_action in ('migrate-to-s3','index') and coalesce(s3_migrated,false)=false
process migrate-to-s3 first, then index rows only if policy allows archive copy
copy Drive content to S3 with path derived from stable file_id and original metadata
record checksum, byte_size, source_file_id, source_modified_time, s3_bucket, s3_key, migrated_at
mark s3_migrated=true only after S3 HEAD/object verification succeeds
insert one gdrive_migration_runs row per batch with discovered/uploaded/skipped/failed/bytes/checksum_failures
never remove, trash, or alter source Drive files
idempotency: skip row if s3_migrated=true and checksum matches
if S3 object exists with matching checksum, mark migrated without re-uploading
if S3 object exists with mismatch, write quarantine receipt and do not overwrite
verify_sql: select migration_action, count(*) total, count(*) filter (where s3_migrated=true) migrated from gdrive_file_index group by migration_action order by migration_action;
select * from gdrive_migration_runs order by created_at desc limit 20;

stages.name: gdrive_dedupe_auto_approval_rules
steps: apply scoring to all pending gdrive_dedupe_plan rows
mark exact duplicates approved_for_archive only; no trash/delete
produce review CSV and JSON with survivor_id, duplicate_id, reason_codes, confidence, proposed_action
enqueue separate archive job only for approved_for_archive rows after source S3 migration proof exists
verify_sql: select status, count(*) from gdrive_dedupe_plan group by status order by status;
select * from gdrive_dedupe_plan where status in ('approved_for_archive','needs_review','blocked_no_action') order by updated_at desc limit 50;

stages.name: approved_duplicate_archive_job
stages.gate: Only archive/trash duplicates if exact duplicate AND migrated proof exists AND not blocked. Do not hard delete.
steps: select approved_for_archive rows with verified survivor and verified S3 archive
move duplicate Drive file to archive folder or Drive trash based on existing T4H archive policy; prefer archive folder if configured
record original parent folders and permissions before move
write restore instructions per file
update dedupe row status='archived' only after metadata verification
rollback: restore original parents from receipt metadata
set dedupe status back to approved_for_archive if restore succeeds
verify_sql: select status, count(*) from gdrive_dedupe_plan group by status order by status;

stages.name: sweeper_dashboard_payload
steps: create or update receipts/runtime/sweeper-dashboard/latest.json
include mac sweeper run health, gdrive migration counts, dedupe states, cron fleet health, scheduler proof, open failures, next jobs
if core.widgets exists, upsert widget record key='sweeper_control_dashboard' with latest receipt pointer
if core.widgets does not exist, write schema-missing finding and skip widget upsert
verify_sql: select * from cron_fleet_runs order by created_at desc limit 20;
select * from autonomy_scheduler_registry where enabled=true order by schedule_key;

definition_of_done.migration: All eligible migrate-to-s3 rows are copied or have explicit failed/quarantine receipts; no source Drive file removed.
definition_of_done.dedupe: All 974 pending candidates are classified; exact duplicates can be approved_for_archive; deletes remain blocked.
definition_of_done.archive: Only exact verified duplicates are archived, with restore receipts; no hard delete.
definition_of_done.audit: audit.log has work_enqueued and terminal work_completed/work_failed rows for fix-sweepers-stage2-20260424-001.

failure_contract.on_error: write error receipt with impact, rollback availability, and next executable job payload
failure_contract.on_partial: continue independent stages where safe, mark blocked dependencies explicitly
failure_contract.on_schema_missing: do not fail whole job; write schema gap and continue receipt-only mode
